description: Points d'accès Wifi Public is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Fleury-sur-Orne. La Ville avec l'aide de l'Europe déploie du Wifi Public. Ce jeu de données recense les points d'accès sur la commune. Coverage: Fleury-sur-Orne. The publisher named on the listing is Fleury-sur-Orne. Its keywords include numerique. The listing shows 6 download or service links in RDF+XML, SHEET, TURTLE, JSON. The listing shows 2020-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
